title: Italy’s CNR presents bifacial PV tile based on spectral splitting
content:
Researchers at Italy’s CNR developed a four-terminal PV tile that uses spectral splitting to direct visible and infrared light to GaAs and bifacial silicon cells, respectively. Outdoor testing confirmed reduced self-shading and enhanced albedo collection, while highlighting opportunities to improve optical efficiency and advance the technology toward commercial applications.

title: European PPA prices rise 2.3% in July
content:
European PPA prices rose 2.3% in July, with gains in Great Britain and Italy offset by declines in the Nordics, Spain and Portugal. Contracting remained active, with 24 PPAs totaling 1.1 GW and nine battery storage agreements representing 865 MW.

title: Korean scientists unveil 10 kW chemical adsorption heat pump prototype
content:
Korean researchers have developed a 10 kW chemical adsorption heat pump that uses waste heat at around 40 C to provide cooling for buildings, factories and data centers. The prototype features a high-performance adsorption bed, an electrochemical compressor with no moving parts and ammonia as a natural refrigerant.

title: India hits $0.068/kWh tariff in 4-hour peak renewable power tender
content:
SECI has discovered a lowest tariff of INR 5.99 ($0.068)/kWh in its 1.5 GW tender for four-hour assured peak renewable power. Waaree Energies secured 700 MW, while NTPC REL and ACME Solar won 500 MW and 300 MW, respectively.

title: US updates foreign inverter ban to include wired devices
content:
